source.title: Cavity-magnon polaritons strongly coupled to phonons

threeModeChain.exactStructuralResult: With g_ma and G nonzero this is an irreducible real symmetric tridiagonal (Jacobi) matrix and therefore has simple eigenvalues; it has no exact degenerate doublet.
threeModeChain.implication: Three strongly coupled species are not the same thing as one bright line plus a protected two-dimensional dark subspace.

measuredNearDoubletAudit.interpretation: Treat the driven upper-polariton/phonon normal-mode pair as a candidate near-doublet and the opposite polariton as the remote line.
measuredNearDoubletAudit.result: Every reported coupling case exceeds the AZ-027 relative-splitting budget; reducing G below the bound does not create a protected two-dimensional eigenspace or the required coupling-vector loop.

fourModeTripod.matrix: H=[[0,k1,k2,k3],[k1*,0,0,0],[k2*,0,0,0],[k3*,0,0,0]] after a common rotating-frame diagonal is removed
fourModeTripod.minimumHardwareChange: Add one independently addressable auxiliary mode coupled to the same central mode, so the central mode has three outer partners rather than two.
candidateAuxiliaries: second mechanical sideband with independent complex pump
requiredControls: three independently calibrated complex couplings k1,k2,k3
common outer-mode rotating-frame frequency to within the residual-splitting budget
loop reversal by phase/control reversal rather than port relabeling alone
two-port coherent process tomography against an external reference
selector Y switched or staged separately from the neutral tripod loop

verdict.physicalFirewall: The result selects an architecture; it is not evidence for a natural selector, Spin(2,3), or new physics.
